⚖️ Legal Update | Supreme Court
Magistrate police ko Charge Sheet file karne ke liye force nahi kar sakta. ❌
Agar police Closure Report file karti hai, toh Magistrate ke paas sirf do options hain:
 ✅ Record ke basis par Cognizance lena.
 ✅ Further Investigation ka order dena.
📌 Case: Brajesh Kumar @ Birjesh Kumar Singh vs State of Bihar & Another (14 July 2026)

comment: A practical angle is the impact on complainants: judicial oversight remains important, but the limits on Magistrate's powers also highlight the need for timely and transparent police investigation decisions.
